$comment: Visual framework registry (Visual Blueprint D5). Metadata only: what each method or standard is, who publishes it, and what a Brand OS page may claim about it. Never a fact store. Validated by npm run validate against schemas/framework-registry.schema.json and the claim rules in visual/framework-registry.ts. informed_by is the only claim used until a person has checked the source and recorded verified_on.

frameworks.title: Business Model Canvas
frameworks.usage_note: Original Brand OS layout of the nine business model components. Not Strategyzer artwork; commercial embedding terms are under review.

frameworks.title: WCAG 2 contrast ratio
frameworks.usage_note: Ratios are computed with the WCAG 2 relative-luminance formula from approved hex values. A ratio is a measurement of two colours, not an accessibility audit or a conformance claim for any product.

frameworks.title: Brand identity guidelines (visual identity chapter)
frameworks.usage_note: Original Brand OS chapter layout for colour, type and logo construction. Values come only from approved facts and the approved master asset.

frameworks.title: Character model sheet (mascot atlas and evolution sheet)
frameworks.usage_note: Original Brand OS layout for a character's expressions, poses and growth stages. Artwork comes only from approved catalog artwork and approved manifest assets; nothing is generated or inferred.

frameworks.title: Customer journey map
frameworks.authority: Service design and UX practice (for example Nielsen Norman Group)
frameworks.edition: Common practice: stages by lanes (touchpoints, actions, emotions, pain points, opportunities)
frameworks.usage_note: Original Brand OS swimlane of the owner's recorded journey stages. Not a research finding: every stage is an owner answer, and evidence is shown as recorded.

frameworks.title: SOSTAC planning model
frameworks.edition: SOSTAC® planning system (situation, objectives, strategy, tactics, action, control)
frameworks.usage_note: SOSTAC® is a registered trade mark of PR Smith. Original Brand OS overview of existing answers by stage; not PR Smith material and not endorsed by PR Smith.

frameworks.title: Objectives and key results (OKR)
frameworks.authority: Andrew Grove (Intel), popularised by John Doerr
frameworks.usage_note: Original Brand OS tree of the owner's objectives and structured key results. Progress is drawn only from a recorded baseline and current value; a target is a plan, not a result.
